svg.aria-label: Two copies of the keyboard from C4 to G4. First copy: C4 (lower voice) and E4 (upper voice) are marked; the keys C, D and E carry the numbers 1, 2 and 3. Second copy: four numbered hops, C4 to C♯4 to D4 to D♯4 to E4, include the two black keys. Three letters, four semitones.
svg.title: Counting letters is not counting semitones

g.text: Count the letters: C D E
Count the hops: every key, black ones too
How to read this graphic: In the first
keyboard the numbers sit only on lettered
white keys, C then D then E. In the second
keyboard each arc is one hop to the very next
key, black or white, from C4 up to E4. Same
two notes, two separate rulers, two different
